newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hitachi to sell Pioneer DVDs under own name - paper.
newsitem.headline: Hitachi to sell Pioneer DVDs under own name - paper.

text.p: Hitachi Ltd will not initially produce its own digital video disc (DVD) players but will sell those made by Pioneer Electronic Corp under the Hitachi brand name, a Japanese newspaper said.
The industrial daily Nikkan Kogyo Shimbun said the decision was made because Hitachi did not think there would be many DVD software titles available on the market soon.

Hitachi officials were not immediately available for comment. DVD is a new recording system which has large storage capacity and is expected to eventually make videocassette recorders, compact disc (CD) players and CD-ROMs obsolete.
Electronics manufacturers such as Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd and Toshiba Corp have said they would produce DVD players and launch them in November.
